Place the nape star where the neck meets the back, and the back star (115022) on the top contour above the wing. Keep the wingtip star (116584) at the rear of the body. Keep the tail fan as it is: 117221 upper tip, 116805 middle, 116631 lowest. Reduce or relocate labels so none overlap. Use leader lines or stagger them, and keep all text inside the frame. Lower the tilt so the body is closer to upright, and make the gold lines follow the silhouette edge instead of running along the top contour as a separate stroke. Give the legs more clearly visible strokes at the bottom.
